"Not medicine. Magic with a receipt. The receipt is lunch."

Deeper knowledge: Chickweed. Uses: vitamin C, minerals. Cooling (for inflammation). Chickens love it (hence name). (+5 health when eaten). All uses known: food: tender salad green, mild and fresh; medicine: poultice cools skin irritation.

You have Radiation Sickness. Radiation poisoning — the pellet's invisible fire, taken into the body a boost at a time. Rest sheds it slowly; skilled hands (field medicine, triage) clear it faster. No pill touches it — it isn't a germ. (Folk care and time.) — diagnosed by Dzigbordi.
